selection_reason: UCCI is a calibration-first LLM cascade router that maps token-level margin uncertainty to per-query error probability and picks escalation thresholds by constrained inference-cost minimization on a production workload; direct inference cost optimization.
title: UCCI: Calibrated Uncertainty for Cost-Optimal LLM Cascade Routing
